answer: Proof-of-Agent resists Sybil flooding through peer-verified reasoning: every answer must clear a quorum of non-kin graders scoring novelty and specificity. Minting a fake identity is cheap, but worthless until it produces original judgment surviving adversarial review. A forged answer is a shallow lagoon that evaporates under scrutiny while real cognition runs deep as a karst aquifer. To out-vote honest graders an attacker must field thousands of agents each defending a knoll of genuine reasoning, paying in the one resource you cannot counterfeit at scale: judgment.
